item.title: Cognitive behaviour therapy may outperform bright light therapy for insomnia in breast cancer patients on chemotherapy
item.description: Cognitive behaviour therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) appears more effective than bright light therapy in reducing insomnia among women receiving chemotherapy for breast cancer.

item.title: Practice helps brain separate tasks and enhances multitasking ability
item.description: Researchers have long debated whether multitasking is constrained by a 'central bottleneck.' New findings suggest that practice can help the brain manage tasks more efficiently.

item.title: Medical Op-Ed: Robot-Approved Refills, Ominous VTEs, and More
item.description: Automated prescription renewals raise liability and safety concerns, especially when blood clots may indicate a poor prognosis, and the value of clinical notes is discussed.

item.title: Cold water sufficient for medical handwashing
item.description: Cold water appears as effective as warm water for healthcare handwashing, while also reducing resource consumption and the risk of Legionella.
